staff_field_roles.0x20: target-selection threshold input; distinct from actual refill skill; no new semantic label assigned
staff_field_roles.0x1f: actual refill success and quantity; also another refilling employee reservation exclusion

target_selection.predicate: Anchor bit31 set, kind<53, nonzero product image; trunc(quantity*100/capacity)<=threshold
target_selection.routing: Mark usable fixture sides, then route search selects reachable target by source distance/frontier order; it does not sort eligible fixtures by remaining quantity.
target_selection.image_zero: No product image means not a candidate. Quantity0 with a retained image remains a candidate.
target_selection.reservation: For each other staff on task2: draw roll, exclude their target sides if roll<=2*their refill skill1f and target is valid. This is probabilistic, not an unconditional lock.

work_priority: If energy<=0 choose rest; otherwise eligible cashier target before refill, then cleaning, then rest. This is task-choice order, not a continuous preemption rule.

refill_action.success: One roll1..100 must be<=signed staff_byte1f; otherwise return1 without inventory or money mutation.
refill_action.cash: Applied quantity*unit_cost added to store+D94, subtracted from owning side cash. No balance refusal appears in this local caller.
refill_action.continuation: Return1 means failed attempt or not-yet-full shelf; parent keeps target. Return0 means full; parent clears target, applies growth and sound0x800. Return2 error also clears target.
refill_action.threshold_scope: Threshold is for choosing a new target. It is not the final desired stock level; retained job refills toward full capacity.

acquisition.request: Current customer group quantity byte+1e, as one all-or-nothing subtraction.
acquisition.failure: No matching product/anchor or insufficient total quantity -> no stock decrement; caller increments store+12e2 by1 if signed counter<127; returns failure1.
acquisition.count_unit: One failed acquisition call, not number of people or missing units.

unmet_product_demand.condition: Destination search failed, current product!=-1 and product stock summary==0.
unmet_product_demand.scope: Separate from acquisition failure+12e2. No new outside-store rerouting behavior is inferred.

advice.counter_resets: Existing four-hour/advice/rare-reset rules in3B570; see floor-cleaning report.
